title: Shared Sky: a pre-registered simulation of delivery drones and air taxis over Houston and Dallas-Fort Worth
description:
Shared Sky simulates the delivery drones that Wing, Zipline and Amazon have filed with the FAA to fly over the same parts of Houston and Dallas-Fort Worth, and counts planned conflicts between companies (two companies' planned paths within 30 m sideways and less than 10 m in height). Headline: giving each company its own height inside the band it already filed cuts planned conflicts by about 72 % (Houston) and 73 % (Dallas-Fort Worth), with no plan sharing between companies.

Every study was pre-registered (prediction, runner and analysis committed before any run). 80 registered studies; 324 predictions passed, 104 failed, 4 not scored. Failures are reported as failures. Includes a re-check of affected studies after an engine review (22-23 November 2026).

This archive is a snapshot of the public repository: simulation engine, runners, analyses, pre-registrations, results, the 3D website and its build. Licences: code AGPL-3.0-or-later; text and results CC BY 4.0; adsb.lol helicopter data ODbL (see LICENSING.md). Not affiliated with Wing, Zipline, Amazon or the FAA. Not a safety assessment.

Website: https://forgottenl5.github.io/shared-sky
